notablePrerequisites: Any mana rock that generates at least one mana.
description:
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, generating two generic mana.
Imprint Mimic Vat with Dross Scorpion.
Activate Mimic Vat, creating a token copy of Dross Scorpion.
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, targeting Mimic Vat and the mana rock with Dross Scorpion's two death triggers (second from Teysa).
